text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both flat to slightly down over the past day, with BTC holding firm near $75.6k while ETH trades around $2.2k, suggesting neither major is under immediate selling pressure despite broader market caution. The Fear & Greed index at 25 signals extreme fear and has deteriorated over the past week, indicating sentiment remains deeply pessimistic even as trading volume at $32B remains modest. Bitcoin's 59.3% dominance reflects steady investor focus on the largest asset, though the weakness across most altcoins like SOL hints at defensive positioning rather than conviction.
